description: Ministry of Justice, Public Administration, Home Affairs - Industrial Dispute between Mr. P. Amila Nishntha and Condominium Management Authority
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns a legal/regulatory matter - an order made under Section 4(1) of The Industrial Disputes Act. It involves the appointment of an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute between specific parties, which falls under legal framework and regulatory procedures. While it mentions Minister Harini Amarasuriya, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is about legal proceedings and dispute resolution mechanisms under established labor laws.
